# Loop

A short-video community. Members post short clips with a caption, scroll a feed of other members' clips, like a clip,
comment on it and reply to other comments, and follow the creators they enjoy. A member's profile shows their clips,
how many followers they have and how many people they follow. Members get notified when someone likes their clip,
replies to their comment or follows them. Anyone can report a clip or a comment; moderators review reports and hide
what breaks the rules.

Look: bold and playful, dark background, a hot pink accent.
